claim_boundary: Uses only events already marked primary_pool_eligible by EXP044.
Does not run SAM or a gate.
Does not extract obj_ptr or compute pointer cosine.
Does not compute percentile ranks or a DI score.
Does not select a hard set.
Does not construct DEV or TEST.
Does not evaluate fresh DEV or TEST.
Both visible-only and literal pre-gap area minima are retained to expose the target-size interpretation before DI-v1 freeze.

protocol.crowding: mean number of nonzero GT object IDs visible per annotation frame across the complete video
protocol.displacement: Euclidean centroid displacement divided by image diagonal
protocol.frame0_anchorability: target object ID has positive GT area in annotation frame 0
protocol.frame0_competitor_count: number of other positive-area GT object IDs in frame 0 when target is present; otherwise all frame-0 objects are reported as non-target objects
protocol.target_size_literal_diagnostic: minimum GT target area fraction over the same exact frame window including zero if absent
protocol.target_size_visible_candidate: minimum positive GT target area fraction among the exact up-to-10 frames immediately preceding disappear_start
